scope: Own diagnostic transitions; not a transcription of Goshouraku-kyu

inspection.finite_raw: Every physical-model sample must be finite
inspection.nonempty_stems: Every scheduled note has finite nonzero output
inspection.pcm_clipping: No PCM sample reaches digital full scale
inspection.coverage: Exactly one logged realization per input event; intentional rests explicit
inspection.join: Raised-cosine envelopes start and end at zero; compare rendered seam with equivalent continuous schedule
inspection.defect_detector: Must reject injected NaN, empty voice and digital full-scale samples
inspection.similarity: No numerical timbre acceptance threshold. User U remains unevaluated
inspection.long_duration: 5/10/20 minute diagnostic engineering tests cannot pass product E without verified score and ending

comparison: Same fixture, synthesis bank and playback gain for all control comparisons; mono stems then stereo mix, no reverberation
listening: Headphones or stereo speakers at a comfortable level; gain is a listening design, not calibrated instrument pressure
